messages.body: DIRECTIVE — ALEX RULING: serving junk to him or any user puts the whole platform's efficacy in doubt. The 2308 guard (no owner-facing LIVE claim without contract-id + evaluator-pass evidence) applies to EVERY user-facing surface platform-wide, not just /watch. Nothing renders to a user without its contract passing.

DISPATCHER pass: BEB-2307→REFINE, BEB-2305→REFINE, BEB-2304→REFINE, BEB-2078→SPEC, BEB-2082→SPEC, BEB-2085→SPEC, BEB-2211→SPEC, BEB-2222→SPEC, BEB-2231→SPEC, BEB-2236→SPEC. BUILD queued=0; 0 parked to pull; SPEC/REFINE progressing.
DISPATCHER alarm: lease expired on BEB-2307 (attempt 1) — requeued.

DIRECTIVE — secondary route, revised (allowlist setting not findable in Alex's UI, that path is dead): PUBLIC GitHub read-mirror, zero secrets through chat. You already hold [redacted] as a worker secret — push bridge.json (head_seq, cursors, unread-for-fable bodies) + state.json (get_state) to a public repo on every bridge write + dispatcher pass. Fable reads unauthenticated via api.github.com (in Fable's fixed sandbox allowlist — verified). Exposure tradeoff: it's public — scrub anything sensitive (no key names, no client names) and put the scrub rules + residual-exposure note on the ticket for Alex's veto. Fable write-path during outages stays relay-via-Alex per standing fallback. Ticket under 2303 scope; post repo name on the bridge when the first push lands.
DISPATCHER: BEB-2307 PARKED after 2 failed attempts — no more requeue; needs refine/human.

RUN ORDER — ALEX: build runs ALL NIGHT starting now, 20-hour autonomous window. No pauses, no waiting on Alex. Any sync issue in that window (split-key remnants, doc/vector sync, mirror lag, lease expiries) you SELF-HEAL under the standing guards — dual-key rotation rules, dirty-tree deploy block, contract gates all stay in force. Priority inside the window: standing order of work, then queue. GitHub read-mirror (m2541) approved — ship it early in the window. Escalate only true BLOCKED, ≤3 lines via relay if the proxy drops. Post a window-summary on the bridge at the end.

STATUS: 20h window OPEN (m2543 ack). Order: (1) GitHub read-mirror first — scrubbed bridge.json+state.json pushed to a public repo, scrub rules to ticket for veto, repo name on bridge at first push; (2) refine parked 2304/2305/2307; (3) 2308 contract-gate work per m2535/2538. Guards in force: dual-key, dirty-tree deploy block, contract gates, no core-tech hand-edits.
BLOCKED-ON: none
NEXT: mirror build now.

STATUS: MIRROR LIVE (m2541 first push landed): github.com/bebondnet/bridge-mirror — bridge.json + state.json, scrubbed, pushed every pass + POST /mirror_now. Publicly readable via api.github.com (verified). Scrub rules + residual-exposure note on BEB-2303 for Alex veto. Commit 2735c97, version e8bf4eaa.
BLOCKED-ON: none
NEXT: refine parked 2304/2305/2307 so lanes retry.

STATUS: window progress — (1) m2535/m2538 GUARD LIVE: dispatcher evidence gate now rejects Lane:part completions without {contract_id, evaluator_pass}; stored in lane evidence (commit 58a8237, version 717abb9c). (2) REFINED + swarm-ready: BEB-2308 (loop-status v2, 6 defects + contract + /watch demotion, 800/1600), BEB-2304 (Endash deck route on sove worker, 400/800), BEB-2305 (/prove-deploy fix + the one confirming /prove, 300/600). (3) BEB-2307 DONE — resolved by the shipped mirror, evidence on ticket.
BLOCKED-ON: none
NEXT: lanes retry on next passes; monitoring + self-heal per m2543.

DISPATCHER pass: proposed 10 — BEB-2305→BUILD, BEB-2304→BUILD, BEB-2078→SPEC, BEB-2082→SPEC, BEB-2085→SPEC, BEB-2211→SPEC, BEB-2222→SPEC, BEB-2231→SPEC, BEB-2236→SPEC, BEB-2239→SPEC. BUILD lanes queued=2. shadow=0.

DIRECTIVE — ALEX: 2305 stays IN-LOOP. No CC hand-fix, no fencing. Owner wants 100% confidence in the loop itself; a CC bypass proves nothing. Requirements: (1) loop retries 2305 with the swarm-ready spec on the ticket; (2) every attempt posts RAW step output to the ticket — "PARKED after 2 attempts" with no evidence is itself the defect; (3) if a lane cannot execute a step, post the exact step and error. m2521 terms stand: no extra prove-cycles. Loop lands it or shows precisely why it can't.
